title: Claude Code hooks announce a session's work through coord.py and show overlapping sessions, leaving the choice to the operator
goal: A SessionStart hook posts the session's intent through coord.py (session id, worktree branch, claimed items) and adds coord.py digest output for keys overlapping this session's claims, within a fixed line budget, naming each other session and its claim and telling Claude to ask the operator whether to wait, join or proceed; a SessionEnd hook releases the session's leases; the hooks call only coord.py commands, so the protocol stays vendor-neutral and hooks are one client of it; no hook exits 2 on an overlap, and a hook prints nothing when no other session overlaps.

gates.question: Where does the SessionStart overlap notice go?
options: Claude's context and the operator's terminal
gates.recommendation: Claude's context and the operator's terminal

gates.question: Besides SessionStart, when do the hooks check for overlaps?
options: also at each backlog.py claim and /kb-research start
gates.recommendation: also at each backlog.py claim and /kb-research start

notes: From the operator interview of 2026-10-15: overlaps inform and the operator decides in the terminal, never a silent block; scales solo one machine first, then several machines, team, organization. Research dedup itself is ST-3qxh5vxo; this hook only shows it. Parked: new orchestration features stay drafts in no sprint until the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness tests pass (operator 2026-10-07), unless the operator lifts that for this epic. Planning before a claim: run backlog.py referrers on the hook registration and on the docs that list SessionStart hooks (maintaining.md, token-efficiency.md, the plugin's hooks file if it mirrors .claude/settings.json).
